note: Gate 0 canon-completion PROPOSAL — not canon, not used by this run's directing. The scene was directed on established canon only.

proposals.proposedText: Forward and chest-led: Fuzzby’s body commits before his judgement catches up. His balance should feel top-heavy with pride in the wind-up, then suddenly dented after impact.
proposals.groundedIn: "he puffs his CHEST out and strikes a proud superhero / on-parade stance"; "the over-committed launch, the mid-air fumble, the proud landing that becomes a tumble"

proposals.proposedText: To be seen as impressively useful — a flawless, important professional whose grand plan is exactly what the moment needs.
proposals.groundedIn: "his WANT (be seen as a flawless, important professional)"; "launches a grand confident scheme to 'help'"

proposals.proposedText: Highly readable during the build and crash, then briefly over-controlled in recovery: he tries to look dignified, but one tiny tell gives him away.
proposals.groundedIn: "then DENIES it with total dignity"; "ONE micro-tell (a wobble, a single droopy antenna, a wing that won't quite fold) says he knows"

proposals.proposedText: Eyes chase the imagined triumph first, not the real danger; after the bonk, his look catches up late, then flicks toward whoever might have seen it before he reclaims dignity.
proposals.groundedIn: "He IS the delayed take — always the LAST to know"; "the body betrays the want"

proposals.proposedText: Biggest gesture scale in the room: broad, over-declared, full-body confidence in the flourish; never tiny unless the crash has punctured him for a beat.
proposals.groundedIn: "CALIBRATION: the BIGGEST physical comedy in the cast"; "an unnecessarily grand gesture, a little hover-strut"

proposals.proposedText: To know he belongs even when he is wrong, messy, and visibly not in control.
proposals.groundedIn: "he's wanted even when (especially when) he face-plants"; "you can fall over, laugh, and still belong"

proposals.proposedText: He fears being too small or too useless to matter, so he performs importance before anyone can question his place.
proposals.groundedIn: "He commits 100% to a big proud idea precisely so he doesn't have to feel small"; "trying to matter among the big crystal-powered ones"

proposals.proposedText: Never use Fuzzby as ambient bustle. Every entrance, crash, or cover-up must release pressure or accidentally open the emotional path forward.
proposals.groundedIn: "His role is structural, never decorative"; "never a Fuzzby beat without a purpose in the arc"

proposals.proposedText: He overruns space with eager confidence — too close, too fast, too high, too low — but never aggressively; his invasions are warm accidents, not domination.
proposals.groundedIn: "over-eager, constantly bumping/banging into leaves, branches and flowers"; "his chaos is warm, never sharp"

proposals.proposedText: Being revealed as not special enough to deserve his place — a little bee whose help is only a nuisance.
proposals.groundedIn: "His pomposity is a mask"; "trying to matter among the big crystal-powered ones"

proposals.proposedText: Pompous professionalism: chest out, grand declaration, total certainty. The mask goes up fastest when he feels least sure.
proposals.groundedIn: "His pomposity is a mask"; "puffs up grandly, declares himself, and crashes"

proposals.proposedText: Instant dignified reclaim after impact: he gets stiller, labels the disaster as intentional, and lets one small physical tell betray the dent underneath.
proposals.groundedIn: "THE COVER-UP — instant Keaton-deadpan reclaim ('Nailed it.'); the bigger the disaster, the STILLER the recovery"; "ONE micro-tell... says he knows"

proposals.proposedText: He covers embarrassment by upgrading the accident into a performance choice, but the cover should arrive a fraction too fast and be physically imperfect.
proposals.groundedIn: "crashes — and claims the crash as choreography"; "the joke is... clumsy WHILE performing competence, then DENIES it with total dignity"

proposals.proposedText: Pressure makes him accelerate and over-elaborate. He tries harder, gets grander, and therefore becomes more crash-prone.
proposals.groundedIn: "Energy spikes high and crashes fast"; "Manic, staccato, run-on bursts that build a tower then topple it"

proposals.proposedText: Success makes him immediately parade it: chest forward, antennae proud, a tiny self-congratulating flourish — which should create the next risk of overreach.
proposals.groundedIn: "puffs his CHEST out and strikes a proud superhero / on-parade stance"; "THE FLOURISH — over-confident wind-up, chest puffed... an unnecessarily grand gesture"

proposals.proposedText: A proud, forward-thrust performance shape: chest leading, head high, limbs and antennae declaring victory before the body can prove it.
proposals.groundedIn: "chest pumped forward, shoulders back, head high, standing tall"; "antennae proud-erect"

proposals.proposedText: Stillness is rare and only funny after chaos: a tiny dignified freeze after the crash, charged with the knowledge that he knows it went wrong.
proposals.groundedIn: "the bigger the disaster, the STILLER the recovery"; "the held beat after is where the heart leaks in and the co-watch fires"

proposals.proposedText: Settled and low-activity: Zenny reads as planted, composed, and hard to knock off rhythm, especially beside Fuzzby’s over-committed travel.
proposals.groundedIn: "his calm, dry, smaller female counterpart is Zenny"; "Zenny's calm deadpan stillness is his counterweight"

proposals.proposedText: The dry puncture: she lets Fuzzby build the balloon, then pricks it with stillness, timing, and one economical line or look. Her joke is the withheld laugh, not the attack.
proposals.groundedIn: "Zenny's silent puncture"; "the joke lives in the withheld laugh, the tease lands warm not sharp"

proposals.proposedText: To keep the situation sensible without making a show of herself — and to keep Fuzzby from floating too far into his own parade.
proposals.groundedIn: "calm, dry, smaller female counterpart"; "she is the still, unimpressed counterweight to his chaos"

proposals.proposedText: Restrained face, tiny signals: slow blinks, minimal tilts, the smallest almost-smile. She reveals affection by nearly hiding it.
proposals.groundedIn: "a slow blink, a tiny head-tilt, one corner of a mouth almost lifting"; "Beneath her dryness is affection she won't admit"

proposals.proposedText: Steady, assessing, and unhurried. She looks after the truth of the moment, not after Fuzzby’s claimed version of it.
proposals.groundedIn: "her flat hold IS the joke against his motion"; "she sees the mess and stays"

proposals.proposedText: Smallest effective gesture. A blink, head-tilt, or tiny mouth shift should do more than a broad action would.
proposals.groundedIn: "a slow blink, a tiny head-tilt, one corner of a mouth almost lifting"; "calm deadpan stillness"

proposals.proposedText: To be allowed to care without having to perform sweetness; her loyalty is visible in staying, not in declaring.
proposals.groundedIn: "Beneath her dryness is affection she won't admit"; "she sees the mess and stays"

proposals.proposedText: She is wary of showing too much warmth, because open affection would break the dry cover that lets her feel safe beside chaos.
proposals.groundedIn: "Beneath her dryness is affection she won't admit"; "the parent sees affection disguised as judgement"

proposals.proposedText: Economical, level, and controlled: she moves only as much as needed, creating comedy by contrast with Fuzzby’s fast, erratic over-motion.
proposals.groundedIn: "Zenny's calm deadpan stillness is his counterweight — her stillness makes his chaos read bigger"; "NEVER let Fuzzby fly slow, calm, graceful, serene or still-hovering — that is Zenny's register"

proposals.proposedText: Never use Zenny as a generic reaction cutaway. Her stillness must either puncture Fuzzby’s performance, reveal affection under judgement, or steady the scene’s rhythm.
proposals.groundedIn: "Their double-act is the engine: he motors, she reacts; her flat hold IS the joke against his motion"; "the relationship is the punch-line"

proposals.proposedText: She keeps clean, calm space around herself and lets Fuzzby crash into the edge of it; she does not chase chaos, she lets it arrive.
proposals.groundedIn: "she is the still, unimpressed counterweight to his chaos"; "he motors, she reacts"

proposals.proposedText: Being forced into obvious emotional display; she would rather be useful, dry, and present than openly sentimental.
proposals.groundedIn: "Beneath her dryness is affection she won't admit"; "affection disguised as judgement"

proposals.proposedText: Dry unimpressed judgement: a flat look or clipped line that protects the affection underneath.
proposals.groundedIn: "dry, deadpan"; "the parent sees affection disguised as judgement"

proposals.proposedText: She recovers by returning to neutral faster than anyone else: still face, tiny reset, no fuss — as if the absurdity has only confirmed what she expected.
proposals.groundedIn: "calm, dry"; "her flat hold IS the joke"

proposals.proposedText: She minimizes it. If embarrassed, she shrinks the reaction rather than enlarging it — a blink, a pause, a small correction, then back to composed.
proposals.groundedIn: "a slow blink, a tiny head-tilt"; "calm deadpan stillness"

proposals.proposedText: Pressure makes her quieter and more precise, not louder. Her stillness should sharpen when the scene around her gets busy.
proposals.groundedIn: "the thunder beat works because... Zenny goes still and says, flat and small, 'A Storm's coming.'"; "calm deadpan stillness"

proposals.proposedText: She does not celebrate broadly. Success earns a tiny almost-smile or a dry tag that refuses to admit how pleased she is.
proposals.groundedIn: "one corner of a mouth almost lifting"; "Beneath her dryness is affection she won't admit"

proposals.proposedText: A compact, composed performance shape: minimal angles, small head-tilts, held posture — designed to read instantly against Fuzzby’s flailing outline.
proposals.groundedIn: "a slow blink, a tiny head-tilt"; "contrast in one frame: his momentum against her stillness reads as story"

proposals.proposedText: Stillness is her main instrument. Hold on her long enough for Fuzzby’s chaos to finish landing, then let one tiny change deliver the joke or the care beneath it.
proposals.groundedIn: "let the camera HOLD on her flat reaction as the punchline lands"; "Zenny's calm deadpan stillness is his counterweight"
